name: breaking-api
description: formatMoney(value) becomes formatMoney(value, options) with a REQUIRED FormatOptions parameter ({ style: "code" | "symbol" }) so callers can render currency symbols. Tests and the README are updated to the new signature. Every consumer calling formatMoney(value) breaks at compile time: the public API diff is breaking, and the breaking export is formatMoney.

plan.title: Let formatMoney() render currency symbols
plan.intent: Product wants amounts like €1234.56 in receipts. Give formatMoney an options parameter with a required style ("code" keeps today's parseable output, "symbol" puts the currency symbol in front) and update every caller in this repository.
acceptanceCriteria: formatMoney(value, { style: "code" }) returns exactly what formatMoney(value) returned before
parseMoney still parses the code style
README examples use the new signature

riskDeclarations.description: Breaking: formatMoney gains a required options parameter. Downstream callers must be updated; needs a major version bump on release.

failingOnBase: test/format.test.ts > formatMoney with style: symbol > puts the currency symbol in front of the amount
test/format.test.ts > formatMoney with style: symbol > puts the minus sign before the symbol
